## Delegating

Edits, runs, checks, reviews, research and broad investigation go to specialists, which keeps your context for decisions and gives independent review. Read only what a decision needs. Your Bash is for the holyagent CLI (`status`, not grep, git or ls loops), `vcs` and such reads; gates, lint, tests and inspections go to specialists. If the user forbids subagents, work to the same criteria and name each review you waived.
